urls.rationale: 29B.60.010 Civil remedies and sanctions-Referral for criminal prosecution - title-wide enforcement reaching lobbyist-disclosure violations (mirror of 42.17A.750).
29B.60.020 Violations-Determination by commission-Penalties-Procedure - PDC enforcement procedure (mirror of 42.17A.755).
29B.60.040 Enforcement-Attorney general - AG enforcement authority (mirror of 42.17A.765).
29B.60.050 Limitation on actions - limitation period for chapter-wide enforcement including lobbyist-disclosure violations (mirror of 42.17A.770).

notes: Chapter 29B.60 has 8 sections; the 4 chosen here mirror the 4 sections the 2015 ground-truth bundle picked from chapter-42.17a enforcement (.750/.755/.765/.770). Excluded: .030 procedure-on-petition (procedural, 42.17A.760 was excluded in 2015), .060 citizen's action (new since 2015, scope is broader chapter-wide), .070 damages/costs (broader chapter-wide), .080 public disclosure transparency account (account creation, not enforcement).
